prompt: All I have is one exact routine name typed out by hand. Give me everything the index knows about it in a single lookup: signature, documentation, complexity, what it calls and what reaches it, its type hierarchy and scope, and a bounded excerpt of its source.
rationale: The live contract takes a NAME or an object id and returns all metadata in one payload. get_context is keyed by object ids from a previous result, which the prompt says it does not have; that is the discriminator between the pair on the live surface.
answer_key_evidence: Given a name or object ID, returns all metadata
